description_en: Retrieves the details of an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
description_zh: 获取云消息队列RabbitMQ的实例
name: GetInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Message Queue for RabbitMQ instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

AutoRenewInstance.description_en: Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance

ClassicEndpoint.description_en: The classic network endpoint. This parameter is deprecated
ClassicEndpoint.description_zh: 经典接入点，该参数不再使用

Edition.description_en:
The deployment architecture. Valid values:

shared: shared architecture, which is suitable for reserved and elastic (shared) instances and pay-as-you-go instances.

dedicated: dedicated architecture, which is suitable for reserved and elastic (dedicated) instances
Edition.description_zh:
Serverless实例部署架构，取值如下：

shared: 共享架构，适用预留+弹性（共享）以及按量付费版本。

dedicated：独享架构，适用预留+弹性（独享）版本

EncryptedInstance.description_en: Indicates whether storage encryption is enabled for the instance data
EncryptedInstance.description_zh: 实例数据存储是否开启存储加密

ExpireTime.description_en:
The timestamp that indicates when the instance expires, in milliseconds.

The value is a long integer. Handle it with care in certain programming languages to prevent precision loss
ExpireTime.description_zh:
实例过期的时间戳，单位：毫秒。
请注意，该值为 Long 类型，在某些语言中可能存在精度丢失的风险，请小心使用

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the instance. A length of 64 characters or less is recommended
InstanceName.description_zh: 需更新的实例名称。取值无限制，建议长度不超过64个字符

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type.

PROFESSIONAL: Professional Edition

ENTERPRISE: Enterprise Edition

VIP: Platinum Edition

SERVERLESS: Serverless Edition
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型。

PROFESSIONAL：专业版

ENTERPRISE：企业版

VIP：铂金版

SERVERLESS：Serverless版

KmsKeyId.description_en: The KMS key ID of the cloud disk

ListenerMode.description_en: The listener mode. A value of tcp_and_ssl enables both port 5672 and 5671, while ssl_only enables only port 5671
ListenerMode.description_zh:
实例端口监听模式：tcp_and_ssl或者ssl_only。
tcp_and_ssl：同时开启5672和5671端口
ssl_only：仅开启5671端口
ListenerMode.title_en:
实例端口监听模式：tcp_and_ssl或者ssl_only。
tcp_and_ssl：同时开启5672和5671端口
ssl_only：仅开启5671端口
ListenerMode.title_zh:
实例端口监听模式：tcp_and_ssl或者ssl_only。
tcp_and_ssl：同时开启5672和5671端口
ssl_only：仅开启5671端口

MaxConnections.description_en:
The maximum number of connections.

For valid values, see the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ purchase page (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)
MaxConnections.description_zh:
最大连接数。

请根据 “云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版-购买页 (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)” 所给出的取值设置

MaxEipTps.description_en:
The peak public TPS.

For valid values, see the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ purchase page (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)
MaxEipTps.description_zh:
公网网TPS流量峰值，单位：TPS。

请根据 “云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版-购买页 (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)” 所给出的取值设置

MaxQueue.description_en: The maximum number of queues for the instance
MaxQueue.description_zh: 实例的Queue的数量上限，单位：个

MaxTps.description_zh: 实例的私网TPS流量峰值，单位：条/秒

MaxVhost.description_en: The maximum number of vhosts for the instance
MaxVhost.description_zh: 实例的Vhost的数量上限，单位：个

OrderCreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp that indicates when the order was created, in milliseconds.

The value is a long integer. Handle it with care in certain programming languages to prevent precision loss
OrderCreateTime.description_zh:
订单创建的时间戳，单位：毫秒。

请注意，该值为 Long 类型，在某些语言中可能存在精度丢失的风险，请小心使用

OrderType.description_en:
The billing method.

PRE_PAID: subscription

POST_PAID: pay-as-you-go
OrderType.description_zh:
订单类型。
PRE_PAID：预付费。
POST_PAID：后付费

PrivateEndpoint.description_en: The VPC endpoint of the instance

ProvisionedCapacity.description_en: The reserved TPS capacity for reserved and elastic instances
ProvisionedCapacity.description_zh: 预留+弹性实例的预留TPS容量

PublicEndpoint.description_en: The public endpoint of the instance

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group for the instance

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The security group ID used to create a PrivateLink endpoint for the instance
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 创建实例填写的安全组，用于创建privateLink接入点
SecurityGroupId.title_en: 安全组，用户创建pvl接入点。
SecurityGroupId.title_zh: 安全组，用户创建pvl接入点。

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

DEPLOYING: The instance is being deployed.

EXPIRED: The instance has expired.

SERVING: The instance is in service.

RELEASED: The instance has been released
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值如下：

DEPLOYING：实例部署中

EXPIRED：实例已过期

SERVING：实例服务中

RELEASED：实例已被释放

StorageSize.description_en:
The disk capacity. Unit: GB.

For Professional and Enterprise Edition instances, this parameter returns -1
StorageSize.description_zh:
磁盘容量，单位：GB。
专业版实例和企业版实例无此参数，返回-1

SupportEIP.description_en: Indicates whether the instance supports EIPs

SupportTracing.description_en: Indicates whether the message trace feature is enabled
SupportTracing.description_zh: 是否开通消息轨迹功能

TracingStorageTime.description_en:
The retention period of message traces. Unit: days. Valid values:

3: 3 days

7: 7 days

15: 15 days

This parameter applies only when `SupportTracing` is set to true
TracingStorageTime.description_zh:
配置消息轨迹的保存时长，单位：天，取值如下：
3：3天
7：7天
15：15天

当SupportTracing为true时，该参数有效

VpcId.description_en: The VPC ID used to create a PrivateLink endpoint for the instance
VpcId.description_zh: 创建实例填写的VPCID，用于创建privateLink接入点

VswitchIds.description_en: The VSwitch IDs used to create a PrivateLink endpoint for the instance
VswitchIds.description_zh: 创建实例填写的vswitchId，用于创建privateLink接入点
VswitchIds.title_en: 创建实例时，用于创建privateLink接入点参数。必须为两个（除个别单可用区地域外）。
VswitchIds.title_zh: 创建实例时，用于创建privateLink接入点参数。必须为两个（除个别单可用区地域外）。

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID generated for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
